an10.212:1.1: Dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an10.212:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇī hatapahate niviṭṭho adayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu.
an10.212:2.10: ‘natthi dinnaṃ natthi yiṭṭhaṃ natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko natthi paro loko, natthi mātā natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ
an10.212:2.12: Imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 3.
an10.212:3.1: Dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an10.212:3.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
an10.212:4.2: pe . . . kāmesu micchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti . . .
an10.212:4.10: ‘atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhiṃ atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko, atthi mātā atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī' ti.
